amendment_reason: Explain hypothesis identifiers and separate the evidence-critical core from model-development and optional diagnostic choices.

parent_protocol.preservation_rule: Retain the parent as a dated design record; use v2.1 for execution.

terminology.H: Hypothesis, meaning a research hypothesis to be tested rather than a model, result, or established fact.
terminology.H048: The testable performance hypothesis corresponding to IDEA-048: the selected low-parameter AST adaptation pipeline improves MeowAgeNet prediction relative to VGGish+MLP.
terminology.H019: The testable method hypothesis corresponding to IDEA-019: the adapter contributes improvement relative to a matched frozen-AST head-only control.
terminology.IDEA: A research direction or design candidate. An IDEA can generate one or more hypotheses, implementations, and experiments.

research_route.working_claim: Low-parameter AST adaptation can improve animal-level feline age classification under cat-ID-disjoint MeowAgeNet evaluation.
research_route.mechanism_boundary: Probe-guided layer selection is an implementation candidate, not a required claim of unique layer semantics.
research_route.idea003_status: paused and excluded from formal v2.1 because the pilot did not improve overall performance

frozen_evidence_core.dataset: the audited 792-call, 111-cat MeowAgeNet analysis view with existing manifest and checksums
frozen_evidence_core.split_rule: cat-ID-disjoint train, validation, and test roles
frozen_evidence_core.formal_baseline: vggish_mlp using the locked audited recipe
frozen_evidence_core.method_control: ast_head_only matched to the selected adapter implementation
frozen_evidence_core.practical_delta_role: reference for effect magnitude, not a mechanical pass/fail threshold
non_negotiable_rules: No cat may cross training, validation, and test roles within a split.
Outer-test outcomes may not select models, layers, epochs, hyperparameters, or repeat count.
Every initiated paired comparison must report all valid runs in its declared scope.
Best-fold and best-seed results may not replace the complete paired summary.
Pilot and formal results must remain distinguishable.

allowed: repair implementation bugs and validate data flow
run smoke tests on synthetic data or inner-training roles
compare IDEA-019 adapter implementations using pilot records or inner-only development evidence
replace the current reference implementation with one documented IDEA-019 candidate before execution lock
adjust batch size or gradient accumulation for hardware feasibility while preserving the declared effective optimization
not_allowed: use formal-v2.1 outer-test outcomes to choose the primary adapter
change cat-ID independence or the primary metric
silently transfer a favorable exploratory result into the formal core
development_window.candidate_change_rule: Record a candidate ID, complete recipe, reason, evidence source, and decision date in the execution lock. Probe-guided remains the default if no replacement is recorded.

formal_core.execution_scope_rule: Choose the exact repeat indices before viewing formal aggregate outcomes and store them in the execution lock. Additional repeats may later be added for resource- or precision-based reasons, but the reason and result-awareness status must be recorded.

H048.plain_language: Does the selected low-parameter AST adaptation pipeline improve MeowAgeNet prediction relative to VGGish+MLP?

H019.plain_language: Does adding the adapter improve prediction relative to an otherwise matched frozen AST with only the classifier head trained?

optional_modules.purpose: check whether a simple fixed cross-depth placement is sufficient
describe generic placement variability without treating a single random pair as representative

optional_modules.pipeline: AST blocks 11 and 12 plus the classifier head
optional_modules.purpose: compare low-parameter adaptation with conventional partial fine-tuning

optional_module_rule: The execution lock lists enabled modules. A module is not required for the core result. Once started, its complete declared paired scope must be reported; unstarted modules may be deferred without making the core incomplete.

analysis.oof_unit: one complete 111-cat out-of-fold prediction set per split repeat and model seed
analysis.primary_summary: report every complete OOF value, the mean paired difference, variability across repeats and seeds, and a paired uncertainty interval
analysis.uncertainty_default: hierarchical paired bootstrap over cats, split repeats, and model seeds
interpretation: Use the sign, magnitude, uncertainty interval, and repeat/seed consistency together.
Treat 0.03 macro F1 as a practical reference rather than a hard success gate.
If the interval includes zero, describe the point estimate and uncertainty rather than declaring equivalence or failure.
A result below zero challenges the corresponding improvement hypothesis under the tested conditions.
Human scientific judgment remains responsible for the final conclusion; the protocol does not automatically accept or reject a hypothesis.
analysis.multiplicity: H048 and H019 are the two declared core comparisons. Optional modules and secondary metrics are diagnostic and remain labeled as such.
analysis.deviation_policy: Preserve v2.1 and record each material deviation with date, reason, result-awareness status, and expected interpretive effect.

must_record: selected primary adapter implementation and full recipe
decision date and formal-outcome access status

future_idea_policy: New ideas remain allowed. Before execution lock they may compete within the documented development window; after execution starts they receive a separate exploratory ID or a later protocol version.
